reviews.text: Francy had been a patient at Neartown for years. During this time the medical staff changed an inordinate number of times. The practice was sold to an individual and ultimately to a conglomerate. I had been pleased with the care Francy received from the previous veterinarians prior to the takeover. Francy recently passed away and I notified Neartown. Not only did the person who answered the phone express no condolences, but I neither heard anything nor received even a card from the practice. Due to the fact that Francy had several health issues, she had several specialists at Gulf Coast. I was truly grateful and overwhelmed by their response, inclusive of phone calls, cards from individuals and a gift. I do not expect the same from Neartown but an acknowledgment tinged with compassion would have been appreciated.
Excellent followup and kept to appt time which was much appreciated. service was wellness checkup and shots.

Excellent experience. The office was so clean. We felt at ease and was promptly taken care of. Dr. N. Qassem was very kind.
She provided great gentle care to Winston. It was not a rushed visit. We were able to ask questions and she was very knowledgeable.
Dr. Qassem assistants Daisy, and Jermih showed interest as well in my pet's well being , handle Winston lovingly. My fur baby was comfortable instantly with all. Certainty appreciated the services rendered. Highly recommended for the care of your loved pet.
Enjoyable experience for both pets and owners! Friendly staff and doctors, and they have been great with my cat. Clean facility, and no wait time. Definitely recommend!

I've been going to Neartown for a several years and the staff and doctors have always been kind and compassionate.  The past few visits I have seen Dr. Johnson and she has been wonderful.  Earlier this week, I brought my dog Wasabi in because I was terrified that he had paraphimosis - normally "it" goes back in but this time I went to bed and woke up in the morning with "it" a bit still sticking out; naturally, I was terrified. Dr. Johnson was able to see Wasabi first thing in the morning and did a thorough exam asking all kinds of questions to help make a diagnosis. It turns out that my little guy had a UTI and hopefully this is the cause for the paraphimosis. I felt bad for not having taken my dog to the vet sooner or catching the problem sooner, but Dr. Johnson never made me feel bad - she really comforted me and put both my dog and I at ease. She exhibited great patience with me and never tried to rush me out the door. She made sure I left having the opportunity to ask any and all questions I might have regarding Wasabi. I  am glad to say Wasabi is picking up more energy and appears to be doing well. Thank you, Dr. Johnson, Destine, and Staff at Neartown.

I had such a wonderful experience at Neartown Animal Clinic and genuinely cannot say enough good things about the team. I brought my cat, Milo, in for a wellness visit and was so impressed with how patient, gentle, and thorough everyone was with him.

Milo can definitely be a little squirmy when he’s uncomfortable, but the staff handled him so calmly and kindly throughout his exam, vaccines, testing, and ear treatment. They gave him plenty of treats, took their time with him, and made the entire visit feel as low-stress as possible. He was surprisingly relaxed for almost the entire appointment, which says a lot about how well they handled him.

Our vet tech, Destine, was incredibly sweet and patient with him and gave him time to get acclimated before doing anything. Dr. Mark Eslick was also fantastic - funny, personable, and very thorough. He explained everything in a way that was easy to understand and made the entire process feel much less overwhelming.

I also really appreciated how thorough they were in addressing everything that came up during the visit and explaining the next steps for his care. I left feeling like Milo was genuinely cared for rather than rushed through an appointment. A few unexpected diagnoses were found during the exam, but everything was clearly explained and they immediately put together an action plan to get him back to feeling his best.

The services were also very reasonably priced considering how much they did during the visit and the medications we went home with.

It can be hard to find a veterinary clinic where you feel completely comfortable trusting people with your pet, and I’m so happy I found this one. I would absolutely recommend Neartown Animal Clinic to anyone looking for a kind, patient, thorough, and attentive veterinary team. Milo and I will definitely be back! 🐾🤍

My poor little true feral kitty has come to 6-7 year middle age cat life and realizes she needs more shelter.  She has mange, she’s gone deaf probably from ear mites that I could never get my hands on her to treat… and other solvable problems.  Solvable only if anesthetized.  This has come about because she decided to live inside with me.
The clinic treated her, bathed her, checked her all out and today she is no longer clawing and biting at herself. She is sleeping peacefully probably for the first time in years.  It was a mercy treatment and her feeling better makes me feel better.

I’ve been with Neartown Animal Clinic for 8 years now, for both my pups and I honestly couldn’t ask for a better place. The entire team is incredibly attentive, caring and professional. Every time we come in, I feel completely confident that my dogs are getting the best care possible.

The doctors and staff are fully at your disposal and so caring with my dogs and I trust the doctors completely. From every annual check up, vaccine tech appointment,  and emergency or even simple concerns I or my pups have.

Neartown Animal Clinic is the best and top care there is for Pets.Thank you for all you do for my babies. 🐶💛 Could not recommend enough!
Dr. Costa quickly diagnosed my dog’s problem and administrated an effective solution.

We love Neartown Animal Clinic - for real !!!!! It is a wonderful place -  and we take it personally because our animals are family. We have been going here for a few years now and have NEVER had any issues. The care from the team - from the moment you walk in the door, to the Vet Assistants, and Vets are amazing. They are on top of everything. Their care and treatment of our cats is nothing less than perfect. We were just in this week and Destiny somehow magically had one of our cats fall in love with her and her personality and handling, along with her insights for us. Then, Dr. Miller examined with the utmost care and transfer of thoughts to us. I highly recommend this place. They will surpass your expectations each time.
Caring and welcoming team! I used them previously and just brought my newly adopted dog in for her initial wellness exam. Always a pleasure!

This vet clinic used to be good with friendly technicians and doctors and my dog loved coming here. Now, it's a completely different story. The front desk is rude and short, in person and on the phone. Last time I was there one of the technicians argued with me over how to bring my dog into the room because she was anxious. I didn't appreciate being talked to like a child, that was so unprofessional. Thirdly, there's no doctors that are quickly in and out. They are nice enough but not very helpful and do not sit with you and take time to explain everything thoroughly.

Lastly, the prices are CRAZY! My dog went in for ONE flu vaccine today and they charged us for the tech visit, a medical waste fee, and the shot (overpriced per other vets) and it was $100! That is crazy for one vaccine! And she was due for another and they forgot to give it to save us money from having to go back. Overall, avoid this place at all costs if you want to save money and be treated with respect.
